name: 10-leases-no-rules
description: Leases, timers and the round limit in a workspace with no rules: the builder releases the task with a reason and claims it again; its lease ends and its late call is refused with lease_expired before any sweep; it claims a third time and submits; the review lease ends and the reviewer claims again; three failed reviews reach the round limit and hold the task with rounds_exceeded; the owner allows one more round, the builder resumes and submits, a fourth failure holds the task again, and the owner cancels it, after which the builder's call is refused with task_cancelled.
covers: PRD Task lifecycle: Release (with a reason), Builder lease expiry, Review lease expiry, Review fails at the round limit, Allow one more round, Cancel (milestone 2 plan TS-8).
PRD test 7 and milestone 2 plan EN-14, EN-15: a call after the due time is refused with lease_expired before any sweep; the expiry is recorded at the due time.

Milestone 2 plan EN-13: rounds_exceeded opens when a failure brings the round to maximum_rounds plus extra_rounds, after the normal move, with the Past the round limit item; the fresh lease is paused while it is open.

Milestone 2 plan EN-31: Allow one more round closes the hold and its item, adds one to extra_rounds and restarts the lease clock; the builder resumes, and the next failure at the new limit opens the hold again.
Milestone 2 plan EN-30: Cancel ends the builder's lease, closes the open step and opens none, closes every open hold and resolves its item; the holder's next call is refused with task_cancelled.
PRD Steps and timing: the first hold's wait_owner step sits between review and wait_builder, the second's ends at Cancel with no step after it, and the steps sum to the task's lifetime.
